steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Cenozoic Era (66 Ma to present) is the 'Age of Mammals' — mammals diversified after the dinosaurs went extinct | Key Fact: The Quaternary Period (2.6 Ma to present) includes the Pleistocene (repeated glaciations) and the Holocene (last 11,700 years, current interglacial) | Key Fact: During the Pleistocene, there were multiple glacial (cold) and interglacial (warm) cycles driven by Milankovitch orbital variations | Key Fact: The last glacial maximum was ~20,000 years ago; ice sheets covered much of Britain down to the Midlands

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from cenozoic era &amp; ice ages, and one past-paper question.
